name: Euryphaessa Space Station
source:
Against all odds, Sirius Chiwase’s small artificial gravity company gets their biggest job to date: the design and installation of a new AG System in the research space station Euryphaessa, located an entire quadrant away. Now him and a team of his most trusted technicians must live in the space station for the foreseeable future, where they’ll meet the cast of colourful characters that call the Euryphaessa their home.

[From [url=https://yamielsun.itch.io/ess-demo]itch.io[/url]]
